protocol.historical_trials: unknown: prior TBot/Tradee history is not attested
protocol.selection: earlier training only; minimum 30 resolved modeled entries; maximize mean net R minus 0.10 times maximum cumulative-R drawdown; lexical scale tie break; require positive mean; otherwise abstain

modeled_execution.entry_clock: first completed 1m candle at/after reaction delay, strictly before 180s expiry; close proxy, not a recorded quote
modeled_execution.ambiguous_path: strict outcome unresolved; separate adverse sensitivity stop first
modeled_execution.funding_schedule: causal projection from previous two observed settlements; model only; actual held settlements reconciled once
modeled_execution.calendar: official reconstructed final schedules when available; not a historical knowledge-time attestation
modeled_execution.metadata: declared research tick/step assumptions; not historical rule attestation

protocol.promotion: disabled: modeled execution and unknown historical trial count cannot satisfy strict release gates

manifest.regime_audit: Common strict-v1 point-in-time labels for every variant; strategy labels retained separately
manifest.note: Modeled diagnostics only. No-exhaustion removes level episode caps and EMA clean-separation; break/retest timing and attempt/risk controls remain. Stress freezes detector plans, not baseline fills. Unknown historical trial count prevents adjusted significance.
